detail: The macro prototype did not compile: the temporary host-pointer macro was missing. Discarded; keep the baseline tree clean.

evidence: Captured all four PONG entry traces after O2 in .auto/pong-traces.ll (untracked diagnostic). The hot ADDR212 trace has only four i8 loads and eight i8 stores, but each of its nine retired CHIP-8 instructions emits an i64 retired-counter load/add/store. Calls to sync_timers, random_byte, draw, skip_key_x_up, and bench_safepoint require architectural state observability. This explains the full-promotion regression: a 16-register exit spill costs more than the eliminated register traffic.
decision: Retain an opt-in LLVM_JIT_DUMP_IR=<pc|*> microscope; do not retry whole-file alloca promotion until a trace-local dirty-register analysis can spill only written, helper-observed registers.

detail: A generator-time dirty mask with spill-dirty/reload-all barriers initially diverged on TETRIS because a helper on one generated control-flow arm reset metadata used by the other arm. Marking all registers dirty after each helper restored differential correctness but measured 39.99 Minsn/s geometric mean versus a ~50 baseline. The remaining exit spills erase the gain. Reverted.
